body: This refspec is exactly the clobber flaw SPEC.md §7.1 warns about: a plain `git fetch` will force-overwrite the local `refs/threads/data` with remote state, orphaning unpublished local events. Should be `+refs/threads/data:refs/threads/remotes/<remote>/data`. Looks like the fetch-clobber fix (43bc41e) updated the spec and the pull/publish path but missed init.
